question: From Tables 3 and 7, how much lighter is the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
From Table 7 (page 5), the mean mass of the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 2.947 g, and from Table 3 (page 3), the mean mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C is 1.118 g. 

The difference in mass is 2.947 - 1.118 = 1.829 g.
